stateNote: Deep-fry for about 2–5 minutes in 175–195 °C fat, depending on the initial temperature of the fries. Work in small enough batches to keep the oil at 125–160 °C for the first 30 seconds of frying. You want to have enough cooking time (7–16 minutes) without allowing the fries to become too greasy.
